create_StableDiffusionMegaPipeline: create a StableDiffusionMegaPipeline instance with vae, text_encoder, tokenizer, unet, scheduler, safety_checker, and feature_extractor components
run_StableDiffusionMegaPipeline_text2img: run text2img to generate images from text prompts using Stable Diffusion with configurable height, width, and guidance scale
run_StableDiffusionMegaPipeline_img2img: run img2img to transform existing images using a text prompt and strength parameter for image-to-image generation
run_StableDiffusionMegaPipeline_inpaint: run inpaint to edit regions of an image using a mask and text prompt for Stable Diffusion inpainting
access_StableDiffusionMegaPipeline_compo: access the components property to retrieve a dictionary of all registered pipeline modules
